title: Jr. Full stack Developer (.NET + Angular)
description:
enguin Data Centre Pvt. Ltd. is a travel technology company developing software solutions for the travel industry. We are looking for a Junior Full Stack Developer with 1–3 years of experience to join our development team and contribute to the development, maintenance, and enhancement of web applications.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with Angular, .NET, and Microsoft SQL Server, along with good problem-solving skills and a willingness to learn new technologies.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, maintain, and enhance web applications using Angular v16/17 and .NET 8.
* Develop and maintain backend services and REST APIs using .NET Core.
* Design, develop, and manage databases using Microsoft SQL Server.
* Integrate frontend applications with backend services and APIs.
* Participate in research and development activities to explore and implement new technologies and solutions.
* Write clean, efficient, maintainable, and well-documented code.
* Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve technical issues and application defects.
* Collaborate with team members to understand requirements, discuss solutions, and complete development tasks.
* Participate in code reviews, testing, debugging, and application optimisation.
* Use Git for version control and source code management.
* Follow established coding standards and Agile software development practices.
* Stay updated on emerging technologies, particularly cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure and AWS.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* ***1–3*** years of professional experience in full-stack application development.
* Strong working knowledge of Angular v16/17.
* Hands-on experience with .NET 8 and .NET Core.
* Good knowledge of C# and object-oriented programming concepts.
* Experience with Microsoft SQL Server, including writing SQL queries and working with database structures.
* Good understanding of REST APIs, including API development, integration, and troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with Git for version control and source code management.
* Understanding of frontend-backend integration and web application development.
* Basic understanding of Agile software development methodologies.
* Good analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills.
* Ability to learn new technologies and adapt to changing project requirements.
* Good communication and teamwork skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure and AWS.
* Exposure to Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Understanding of application deployment, performance optimisation, and software development best practices.
* Experience working on research and development projects.

Pay: ₹18,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Experience:

* .NET: 1 year (Required)
* Angular: 1 year (Required)
* Microsoft SQL Server: 1 year (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

title: Full Stack Developer (Client Facing Role)
description:

* Experience working in an **Agile environment** is an advantage.

title: EJ 1516 Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
Role Summary

Softobiz is looking for a Senior MERN Stack Developer to join the engineering team. You will be responsible for designing and delivering end-to-end features across our Node.js backend and React frontend, taking ownership from API design through to UI delivery. This role is being hired to backfill a departing team member, so the ideal candidate can ramp up quickly and take over an existing area of the codebase with minimal disruption to delivery. AI-based development is central to how the engineering team works. We are specifically looking for someone well versed in AI-assisted development - comfortable using AI coding assistants as part of their daily workflow to design, build, test, and ship features faster and with higher quality.

Key Responsibilities

  

Backend Development

• Design and implement RESTful APIs using Node.js and Express, with clean, well-tested, maintainable code. • Model data and optimize MongoDB queries for large data volumes, keeping performance and scalability in mind. • Integrate with third-party services and internal systems, handling authentication, validation, and error management. Frontend Development • Build and maintain complex front-end applications using React, including state management, component testing, and performance tuning. • Collaborate closely with product management, design, and QA to define requirements and deliver high-quality features.

AI-Assisted Development

  

• Use AI coding assistants (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar) as a core part of the daily development workflow - for code generation, refactoring, review, and test creation. • Apply AI-assisted approaches to accelerate feature delivery without compromising code quality or test coverage. • Share learnings and best practices on AI-assisted development with the wider team.

  

Quality, Delivery & Operations

• Drive best practices in code quality, testing, and CI/CD across the codebase. • Troubleshoot production issues and lead performance optimization efforts. • Take end-to-end ownership of features, ensuring consistency and reliability across the full stack.

  

Required Technical Skills

  

Domain Skills & Technologies

JavaScript, TypeScript, SQL Must

Backend Node.js, Express.js, RESTful API design, Webhook integrations Must

Frontend React 18, Redux / Context API, HTML5, CSS3 Must

Database MongoDB - data modeling and query optimization for large data volumes Must

Testing Jest, React Testing Library (or similar) - unit, integration, and end-to-end testing Must

DevOps / CI-CD Git, GitHub Actions (or equivalent), CI/CD pipeline management Must

AI-Assisted Development - Daily, hands-on use of AI coding assistants (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) for code generation, review, and testing - primary hiring criterion for this role Must

  

Preferred:

Auth & Security OAuth, JWT, session management

Cloud Platforms AWS, GCP, or Azure - deployment, scaling, infrastructure management

API & Architecture Patterns Container Orchestration GraphQL, microservices, serverless architectures

Docker

Experience building AI agents or LLM-powered AI Agent Development features (e.g., agentic workflows, RAG, tool Preferred calling)

  

Qualifications & Certifications

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

• 6-9 years of professional, hands-on full stack development experience with Node.js, React, and MongoDB (MERN) in production environments. • Demonstrated, hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools and workflows in real projects - mandatory, not just casual/occasional use. • Deep understanding of REST API design, microservices, and scalability patterns. • Strong testing skills (unit, integration, end-to-end) using Jest, React Testing Library, or similar. • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and CI/CD pipelines.

  

Soft Skills & Cultural Fit

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with effective cross-functional collaboration. • Comfortable working independently during IST hours while collaborating with international clients and team members across time zones. • High sense of ownership - able to pick up an existing codebase quickly and take it forward with minimal hand-holding. • Curious, growth-oriented mindset, with genuine enthusiasm for AI-assisted engineering practices. Confidential 3 PEOPLE & DELIVERY

  

What We Offer

• Opportunity to work on real-world product engineering platform. • A team culture built around AI-first development - access to modern AI coding tools and workflows from day one. • Collaborative, technically strong team with a culture of code quality and continuous improvement. • Competitive compensation and professional development support.

title: Senior Full Stack (Dot NET & REACT JS) Developer
description:
**Senior Full Stack (Dot NET \& REACT JS) Developer** :

**Experience:** 5\+ Years

**Role:** Full Stack Developer

**Technology:** .NET / C\# / React / SQL Server / Web API

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced **Full Stack .NET \+ React Developer with 5\+ years of experience** to design, develop, maintain, and enhance enterprise applications.

The candidate should have strong experience in **C\#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, Web API, React, and SQL Server**, along with a good understanding of **Clean Architecture, Layered Architecture, REST APIs, and object\-oriented programming**.

The candidate will work on existing applications as well as new feature development, bug fixing, performance improvements, API integrations, and production support/development activities.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain applications using **C\#, .NET / ASP.NET Core, Web API, and React**.
* Develop reusable, scalable, and maintainable backend and frontend components.
* Work with existing **Clean Architecture and Layered Architecture** based applications.
* Work on **RESTful Web APIs**.
* Design and implement business logic, services, repositories, and API endpoints.
* Develop responsive and user\-friendly interfaces using **React.js**.
* Integrate React applications with .NET Web APIs.
* Work with **SQL Server**, including queries, stored procedures, joins, views, and database optimization.
* Implement authentication, authorization, validation, exception handling, and logging.
* Analyze and troubleshoot application, API, database, and integration issues.
* Perform code reviews and follow coding standards and best practices.
* Write unit tests and participate in integration and functional testing.
* Work with existing codebases and understand the impact of changes across different application layers.
* Collaborate with business analysts, QA teams, DevOps teams, and other developers.
* Participate in deployment, issue investigation, and application maintenance activities.
* Identify performance and scalability improvements and implement appropriate solutions.

**Required Technical Skills**

**Backend** :

* 5\+ years of experience in **.NET / C\# development**.
* Strong knowledge of **ASP.NET Core / .NET Web API**.
* Good understanding of **MVC architecture**.
* Strong knowledge of **OOP, SOLID principles, Design Patterns, and Dependency Injection**.
* Experience with **RESTful APIs and third\-party API integrations**.
* Good understanding of asynchronous programming, exception handling, logging, and API security.

**Frontend**

* Strong experience with **React.js**.
* Good knowledge of JavaScript / TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS.
* Experience with React components, hooks, state management, API integration, and form validation.
* Understanding of frontend performance and reusable component development.

**Architecture**

* Good understanding of **Clean Architecture** and **Layered Architecture**.
* Ability to work with applications containing separate **API, Business, Data Access, Domain/Entity, and UI layers**.

Ability to understand and work with existing architecture and coding standards

Pay: ₹60,000\.00 \- ₹70,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund
